azure.review.apim.selected_operation_bre.title: Selected APIM observed caller operation breadth stays within the selected threshold
azure.review.apim.selected_operation_bre.description: Compares the maximum caller operation breadth in matching visible ingested records from one selected APIM/workspace and fixed hour against an explicit threshold. Operation IDs are caller-selected APIM identifiers; this is neither compromise detection nor an alert-delivery test.
remediation: Review the selected APIM operation IDs, threshold and matching traffic with the service owner.
Investigate unexpected operation breadth using separately authorized monitoring tools.
